limitations: Fixed bounded retained reads; no deployed commit, market-wide completeness, historical as-of or publisher SLA verified. Quantity/detail samples bounded to first five; ranking groups preserved.

quantity_groups.denominator_definition: Sum of the reported native buy or sell quantity for every branch row returned by this provider, unit, precision, and requested range. It is an observed-source denominator, not an all-market denominator.

units.quantities: provider-native; Capital lots or TWSE shares, never converted or combined
units.precision_shares: reported native quantity precision metadata; not a share conversion
units.vwap: source buy/sell transaction VWAP in TWD per share; not position cost basis
units.price_levels: TWD per share with exact TWSE shares
units.concentration: percent of observed branch-side native quantity within one provider/unit/precision group

evidence.denominator_limit: Concentration uses only returned branch rows for a single provider-native group; it is not a market-wide measure, especially when source coverage is incomplete.
evidence.vwap_meaning: Buy/sell transaction average reported by the source; it does not describe branch inventory cost basis.
evidence.price_level_empty_semantics: A successful empty detail response means an EMPTY or FAILED projection exists; the endpoint does not identify which status.
evidence.provenance_limit: Canonical broker-flow responses expose per-row revision IDs but no source receipt, capture ID, or publisher publication time.

freshness.frequency_hint: 日資料；分點數量依來源分界與原生單位分組，覆蓋未證明全市場完整度；來源未提供接收時間或更新期限。
